# Seamly

> > Seamly is an open-source 2D/3D CAD platform for fashion design, pattern-making, and digital clothing creation.

Seamly provides professional-grade fashion design software built on open-source principles, enabling designers to create patterns and garments digitally. The platform integrates with emerging technologies like 3D body scanning and mixed reality for next-generation fashion workflows.
